messages:
Clara Zhou: FYI — Aurora Labs wants to renew early and shuffle 35 seats from 'infra-dev' to 'infra-prod'. They asked for a 14% early-sign discount if DocuSign completed by 2024-12-07 and a prorated credit for the unused seats through 2025-06-30. Also they need the invoice billed to their EU subsidiary (Aurora Labs GmbH). Need billing/legal/onboarding.
Diego Morales: 14% is above CS approval. Finance will need PO + credit approval. What's the ARR on those 35 seats?
Clara Zhou: Seat rate is $48/mo on the current annual term. 35 seats = $20,160 ARR. They want term to remain 12 months starting on their renewal date.
Priya Desai: Onboarding: moving seats is straightforward but we need the user CSV and confirmation of SSO groups. Migration window estimate: 45 minutes with rekeying if apps are tied to groups. Sophie can run the script once we get the list.
Sophie Tran: Looping in onboarding ops: please send CSV to onboarding@redwood.com with subject "Aurora-seat-move-35" and preferred migration window. I recommend 2024-12-02 03:00 UTC to avoid business hours.
Liam O'Connor: Legal: we'll draft an amendment. Include standard prorate formula: credit = seat_price * remaining_days / 365. Also require a clause: "Execution closes all claims related to prior seat allocations." Will attach redline.
billing-bot: Provisional credit calc created: PC-2791012345-AUR (link: https://billing.internal/adj/PC-2791012345-AUR). Estimated credit = $48 * remaining_days / 365 * 35.
Diego Morales: Finance: willing to approve 14% if: 1) signed PO references INV-8421, 2) DocuSign by 2024-12-07, and 3) EU billing entity provided with tax ID. Otherwise discount drops to 8%.
Clara Zhou: Customer says PO will reference INV-8421 and finance details are Aurora Labs GmbH, DE-TAX-44901. They prefer credit applied as invoice adjustment not cash refund.
Priya Desai: Noted. Once PO lands I'll queue the onboarding run and Sophie please confirm slot.
Sophie Tran: Confirmed. I can take 2024-12-02 03:00 UTC. Please send CSV by EOD 2024-11-29.
Liam O'Connor: Uploaded amendment redline: https://redwood.internal/docs/addenda/aurora-seat-move_redline.docx — added prorate calc and "no further concessions" language.
Clara Zhou: I'll route DocuSign to renewals@aurora.com cc legal@redwood.com. Target signature 2024-12-05 to allow time for PO processing. :thumbsup:
Diego Morales: Once PO and signed addendum present, finance will issue final provisional invoice and apply credit referencing INV-8421.
Clara Zhou: Thanks all 12 I'll post the PO when it arrives and close the loop.
